triage_summary.vulnerability: load() follows symlinks without validation, allowing arbitrary file read
triage_summary.root_cause: Path.read_text() and Path.stat() follow symlinks by default in load() method
triage_summary.proposed_fix: Add self.path.is_symlink() check before reading file in load() method

plan.approach: TDD - Test-first regression tests, then minimal fix
implementation_sequence: 1. Add failing regression tests for symlink protection in load()
2. Add self.path.is_symlink() check in load() before reading file
3. Raise ValueError with clear security message if symlink detected

verification_targets: Test symlink pointing to /etc/passwd raises ValueError
Test normal file loading still works
Test error message indicates security reason

pr.title: [AUTOFIX][ISSUE-6463][CANDIDATE-2] fix(security): add symlink validation in load() to prevent arbitrary file read
